Ajinkya Rahane Retires From International Cricket

Ajinkya Rahane announced his retirement from all forms of international cricket on June 4. He played 85 Test matches, 29 One Day Internationals, and 20 Twenty20 Internationals for India. Rahane was part of the team that secured India's historic Test series victory in Australia in 2020-21. Virat Kohli described Rahane as his "favourite batting partner," and Sachin Tendulkar hailed his "remarkable career."
